name: Should I hire a cabinet removal crew or just do it myself?

mainEntity.name: Should I hire a cabinet removal crew or just do it myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you are comparing removal options, ask whether the crew handles just cabinets or also countertops, appliances, trim, and final haul-away. For homeowners in Centennial, Greenwood Village, Parker, and nearby areas, the better choice is usually the one that matches your renovation timeline, protects surrounding finishes, and gives you a clear scope before work begins.
acceptedAnswer.description: DIY can work for simple cabinets, but a crew is usually better if counters, appliances, trim, or utility disconnects are involved. Choose the option that best fits your timeline and the amount of protection your kitchen needs.
